sentences.en: The film studio has just released its latest movie.
sentences.zh: 这家电影制片厂刚刚发布了它的最新电影。

sentences.en: Many actors dream of working in a famous film studio.
sentences.zh: 许多演员梦想在著名的电影制片厂工作。

sentences.en: We visited the historic film studio where many classics were made.
sentences.zh: 我们参观了拍摄了许多经典作品的历史悠久的电影制片厂。
